committee.sub: Morning brief · Monday 5 October 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Spend rose to $146.25 from $118.67 while CPC crept to $6.09 and conversions stayed at zero. Since the restart, 90 of the pre-agreed 150 stop-loss clicks have run with still no leads, so the clock keeps ticking toward that threshold.

Rank lost (73.8) still dwarfs budget lost (21.2) over the past 30 days, with impression share at just 10 percent. Until that gap closes, this is a quality/relevance constraint, not a budget one, so the budget conversation stays shut.
Sessions jumped 46 percent to 60 this week, yet calculator.usedLast7 fell to 0 from 1 the week before. The funnel's middle step is not converting the traffic increase into engagement.

AI Assistant sessions dropped to 0 from 2, with the chatgpt.com referral that drove them gone entirely this week. LinkedIn referral also went to 0 from 1, worth checking whether recent posts were tagged.

actions.text: Logo and image assets plus keyword-matched RSA headlines for the currently serving ad groups are still outstanding, action when capacity allows.
The homepage form still fires kontrolTrackLead before the Formspree verdict rather than after it confirms. Fix the confirm-then-count logic so lead counts reflect genuine submissions.
RSA description D1 still claims 13.3 hours of admin per week. Update the copy to match current site stats before it runs further.
